proposal.rationale: Design a cheap falsifiable test of the fictional workflow problem.
proposal.title: First experiment: example-founder
proposal.targetAudience: Not selected. Identify who would benefit before committing to an experiment.
proposal.problem: The need addressed by this mission remains untested: Develop a venture consistent with the configured mission. Identify assumptions, gather evidence, propose bounded experiments, and retain what is learned.
proposal.hypothesis: A small facilitated pilot may establish whether the intended audience can achieve a useful outcome related to the mission.
proposal.smallestTest: Facilitate one representative audience activity manually before committing to a full venture.

successCriterion.metric: Participants completing the agreed activity without facilitator intervention

proposal.stopCondition: Stop if the need is not recurring or fewer than three of five participants complete the activity.
proposal.maintenancePlan: Assign an owner for feedback triage and delete test data after the agreed retention period.

experiment.title: First experiment: example-founder
experiment.summary: A synthetic experiment design. There are no real participants, measured results, or deployed software.
prototypeBehavior: Specify one audience activity related to the founder mission.
Provide the minimum manual pilot needed to attempt that activity.
testSteps: Obtain agreement from five relevant participants for a future test.
Define one representative activity and a clear completion condition.
Observe each participant attempt the activity.
Record outcomes against the original criterion.
acceptanceChecks: The activity has a clear completion condition.
The observer can tell whether facilitator intervention was needed.
experiment.recruitingPlan: Prepare a recruitment brief for the owner; no outreach is sent by this harness.
experiment.instrumentation: Record participant pseudonym, completion, and facilitator intervention. Keep personal information private.
experiment.supportPlan: One person owns questions during the seven-day test; no live service is promised.
limitations: This package does not contain executable software.
